text.p: These are the leading stories in the Moroccan press on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Crown Prince Mohamed, at opening of seminar on "World democratic transitions", says democracy needs constant efforts.
- British tycoon Richard Branson about to take off from Marrakesh for his round-the-world balloon flight.
- Truck collision kills three and injures four near Marrakesh.
- Taxi drivers say they will pursue strike until their demands for lower insurance costs are met.
- Palestinian housing and social affairs ministers visit Morocco to boost cooperation.
- Malian Prime Minister Ibrahim Keita visits Morocco at the invitation of Moroccan counterpart Abdellatif Filali.
